                  Sim_ProcessInput PROC
;;;305    
;;;306    void Sim_ProcessInput(void) {
000000  b510              PUSH     {r4,lr}
;;;307        static uint32_t last_update = 0;
;;;308        uint32_t now = tickTimer_GetCount();

000006  4604              MOV      r4,r0
